experience_thesis: The site is the farm's open record — a printed agricultural ledger you can read to know exactly what is growing, where, and what was done to it, which is a thing no competitor publishes and a thing that cannot be faked.

brand.promise: Built on purpose. Rooted in strength. Living soil inside engineered hardware, and an honest account of both.
anti_tone: anything that implies a red barn and a cornfield
brand.trust_posture: Every crop shown is one the farm actually grows; anything not yet confirmed is absent rather than approximated. The record is dated.
brand.audience_sophistication: Local buyers who want to know where food came from, and chefs who need to know what is cuttable this week.

composition.layout_model: A printed record. Ruled columns, a wide outer margin like a bound page, headings set as if they were struck rather than styled.
composition.grid: Single measured text column on phones; on desktop a narrow index margin beside a wide record body. Never a 12-column card grid.
composition.rhythm: Dense in the record itself — rows tight, the way a real book is — with long exhales between registers. Deliberately uneven: no two sections share a padding value.
focal_path: Where it is grown — bench or field
What was done to the soil
composition.dominant_mass: The record table. It is the biggest, densest, blackest thing on the page and nothing competes with it.
composition.negative_space: Wide outer margins, as on a printed page. Space is the binding, not decoration.

intensity_map.purpose: The signature — the thing to remember
Separate indoor bench from outdoor ground
Answer a question, get out of the way

color.contrast_strategy: Two inks on paper — near-black for everything, iron-oxide red used only for what is cuttable today, the way a ledger keeps one red pen. Red is never decorative and never used twice on a line.
color.glow_policy: None. There is no glow anywhere on this site. Paper does not glow.

typography.display_voice: Old-style reading serif at large size — authority from the letterforms, not from weight or contrast. Explicitly not a high-contrast display serif, which is the generated default.
typography.body_voice: The same serif at reading size, set long and generous.
typography.technical_voice: Monospace for every date, quantity, week number and column in the record — the numbers are the content, so they get their own voice and they align.
typography.scale: Modest. The record table's own type is nearly the same size as body text, because a ledger does not shout its rows.
typography.line_length: 62–72 characters for prose; the record is tabular and ignores measure.
typography.variable_font_strategy: Two families only, self-hosted, subset, weights trimmed to what is used. No third family.

spacing_and_shape.section_rhythm: Deliberately unequal. The record is tight against its heading; the registers are separated by a full exhale. Any two adjacent sections sharing a vertical padding value is a defect.
spacing_and_shape.border_language: Horizontal rules only, hairline, in rule-grey. No boxes, no panels, no cards, no rounded corners anywhere. Vertical separation comes from rules and space.

material.surface_language: Paper. One continuous sheet — the page does not stack surfaces at different elevations.
material.light: Flat and even, as on a printed page under a window. There is no light source in this design.
material.depth: None. Everything sits on the same plane. Depth is expressed by ink weight, not by shadow.
material.texture: A very faint paper tooth at low opacity, never behind body text.
material.transparency_policy: None. No translucency, no backdrop blur, anywhere.
material.shadow_policy: No shadows. Not on hover, not on focus, not on anything.

imagery.photography: None, by decision, until the room is running and the owner supplies real photographs. The composition has no photographic slots, so nothing reads as missing. When real photographs exist they enter as a separate plate section, not as a hero.
imagery.illustration: Hand-authored SVG in the manner of an agricultural bulletin figure: the AutoPot cutaway, the living-soil column, the soil food web. Line work only, ink on paper, labelled and captioned like a figure. Drawings declare themselves as drawings and never imply they depict this specific room.
imagery.icons: Almost none. Where a mark is needed it is typographic — a dagger, a rule, a bullet.
imagery.maps: A text address and one link out. No embedded interactive map on the front page and no map-shaped placeholder ever.
imagery.data_visualization: The record table is the data visualization and it is a table, because the reader's job is to look up a row. No timelines, no bars, no Gantt-shaped rows, no charts of things that are not quantities.
imagery.asset_provenance_rule: No generated photographic imagery, ever. No stock photograph of someone else's grow presented as this farm. Every drawing is authored in-repo and every photograph is the owner's own.

motion.tempo: Almost none. Under 150ms where it exists.

grammar.row_change: no animation — the date stamp carries the change

motion.scroll_policy: Standard scrolling only. No scroll-driven animation, no pinning, no parallax, no reveal-on-scroll. Content is present in the document from the first paint.
motion.pointer_policy: No element responds to cursor position. Nothing tilts, follows, or glows under the pointer.
motion.reduced_motion: There is nothing to reduce. The page is identical with prefers-reduced-motion set, which is the point.

responsive.mobile_composition: The record first, full width, rules running edge to edge with a 16px gutter. The masthead compresses to one line. Nothing is hidden behind a disclosure that matters.
responsive.desktop_expansion: A narrow index margin appears at the left carrying the register names and the date; the record body widens but the prose measure does not. Desktop is not the mobile layout stretched.
content_extremes: no crops cuttable at all — the honest empty state, which will be the state at launch
a crop name far longer than the column
responsive.zoom_and_reflow: The record reflows to stacked rows before it scrolls horizontally. At 200% zoom and 320px width there is no horizontal page scroll.

render.activation_reason: The entire experience is text, rules and a small number of inline SVG figures. There is no case for motion, canvas or GPU work, and reaching for one would contradict the direction.

budgets.javascript: No client JavaScript on any content route. Any island must be justified in writing first.
budgets.fonts: Two self-hosted families, subset, under 90KB total
budgets.images: No raster images on content routes until the owner supplies photographs
budgets.lcp: Under 1.5s on throttled mobile — the LCP element is text

render.fallback: The page is already its own fallback. With CSS disabled it is a readable document.

accessibility.contrast: WCAG 2.2 AA minimum. Near-black on warm paper clears AAA for body text; the iron red is verified against paper for both normal and large text before use.
accessibility.semantic_equivalent: The record is a real HTML table with a caption and scope attributes. Every figure has a text description of what it shows. Nothing is communicated by color alone — cuttable rows are marked in words as well as in red.
accessibility.motion_control: Not applicable by design; there is no nonessential motion to stop.
accessibility.focus_and_input: Solid two-pixel ink outline with offset, visible on paper, never removed. Full keyboard operation. Touch targets at least 44px.

anti_patterns: uniform vertical padding across sections — the single loudest machine tell
gradient or chrome fill on text
uppercase letter-spaced micro-labels as section eyebrows
cards, panels, boxes, rounded corners, or borders that enclose on four sides
glass, blur, glow, or drop shadow of any kind
a hero image slot, or any layout shaped for a photograph that does not exist
dashed placeholder rectangles or 'coming soon' boxes
timeline, Gantt or progress-bar treatments of non-quantities
an invented signature motif that cannot be explained in one sentence about the business
rendered copy that names a file, framework or variable
publishing any crop the owner has not confirmed growing

reference_sources.source: Printed agricultural extension bulletins and seed catalogues
take: ruled record tables as the dominant element
avoid: imitating any specific publication's masthead or trade dress
reproducing the artwork as a hero image
inventing additional marks in its style
